scope: Production build on loopback; isolated database across three server processes
checks: Fresh database shows the actual empty catalogue state
Catalogue error state recovers through its Try again button
Reversed availability dates show validation without sending a match request
Operator can reject a blocked draft through the UI; it stays private
Graceful process restart preserves published, draft, rejected, source, organization, import and audit records
Restart with a new reviewer token invalidates the previous signed cookie
Same-day fixture replay after restart remains idempotent and published
A rotated reviewer session clears the stale console and prompts sign-in
Abrupt process termination preserves acknowledged writes and suspended publication on restart
Closeout browser paths have no runtime errors or external requests
limits: This proves process restart recovery, not machine power-loss durability, backup restoration or production authentication.
